title: Grok Build plugin manifest traps
body:
Point mcpServers in .grok-plugin/plugin.json at a file (./.grok-plugin/mcp.json) anchored with ${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT}. Never inline it, never use ${VAR:-default}, and name the marketplace plugin source by git URL, not "./". Check changes with `grok mcp doctor` from an isolated HOME/USERPROFILE, not `grok plugin validate`.

Why: Grok 1.0.41 ignored an inline mcpServers object and fell back to the root .mcp.json, whose relative mcp.js resolved in the user's project; it expands ${VAR} but not ${VAR:-default}; its marketplace rejects "./" as 'marketplace path is empty'. grok plugin validate passed on all of these.

evidence.summary: Section 'How the manifest is laid out, and why' records each finding from grok mcp doctor on 2026-09-23
Test pins the file-path mcpServers, the GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT anchor and the url marketplace source
Anchored delivery: keywords validated against this memory's own text and a generic-request corpus before proposing.
